tasks.label: Build with colcon
args: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${env:HOME}/.local/ranger_llm_ui_py310" && colcon build --paths . ranger_llm_msgs --packages-select ranger_llm_msgs ranger_llm_ui

tasks.label: Launch Ranger LLM UI
args: set -a && source .env && set +a && export PYTHONUSERBASE="${env:HOME}/.local/ranger_llm_ui_py310" && export PYTHONPATH="${env:HOME}/.local/ranger_llm_ui_py310/lib/python3.10/site-packages:$PYTHONPATH" && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PYTHONUSERBASE/lib/python3.10/site-packages/nvidia/cu12/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" && source ./install/setup.bash && ros2 launch ranger_llm_ui ranger_llm_ui.launch.py

tasks.label: Start CLIProxyAPI (Claude OAuth)
tasks.detail: Starts CLIProxyAPI on :8317 wrapping Claude Pro/Max OAuth as an Anthropic-compatible HTTP endpoint. One-time login via './cli-proxy-api -claude-login -no-browser -config config.yaml' before first run.
args: cd ${env:HOME}/tools/cliproxyapi && pkill -x cli-proxy-api 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; ./cli-proxy-api -config config.yaml 2>&1 | tee /tmp/cliproxy.log

tasks.label: Launch Ranger LLM UI (claude_proxy, simulation)
tasks.detail: Launches the Gradio UI with provider=claude_proxy using Claude Pro/Max via CLIProxyAPI. Run 'Start CLIProxyAPI' first.
args: set -a && source .env && set +a && export PYTHONUSERBASE="${env:HOME}/.local/ranger_llm_ui_py310" && export PYTHONPATH="${env:HOME}/.local/ranger_llm_ui_py310/lib/python3.10/site-packages:$PYTHONPATH" && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PYTHONUSERBASE/lib/python3.10/site-packages/nvidia/cu12/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" && export WHISPER_MODEL=${WHISPER_MODEL:-base.en} && export LLM_PROVIDER=claude_proxy && export LLM_MODEL=${LLM_MODEL:-sonnet-4.6} && python -m ranger_llm_ui.ui_node --provider claude_proxy --model ${LLM_MODEL:-sonnet-4.6}

tasks.label: Run claude_proxy stack (proxy + UI)
tasks.detail: Convenience: starts CLIProxyAPI and the Ranger UI side-by-side in dedicated panels.

tasks.label: CLIProxyAPI: Claude OAuth Login (one-time)
tasks.detail: Run once to authenticate CLIProxyAPI with your Claude Pro/Max subscription. Follow the printed SSH-tunnel + browser instructions.
